question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
-- Step 7: Find the product in top 20% (quintile 1) with smallest absolute share change
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_city_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cs1772.cust_city
    FROM city_sales cs1772
    JOIN city_sales cs1776 ON cs1772.cust_city = cs1776.cust_city
    WHERE cs1772.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
      AND cs1776.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
      AND cs1772.total_city_sales > 0
      AND 100.0 * (cs1776.total_city_sales - cs1772.total_city_sales) / cs1772.total_city_sales >= 20
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        p.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_city_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, p.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(product_city_sales) as quarter_total_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        pcs.prod_id,
        pcs.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(pcs.product_city_sales) as prod_quarter_sales
    FROM product_city_sales pcs
    GROUP BY pcs.prod_id, pcs.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        pqs.prod_id,
        pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
        pqs.prod_quarter_sales,
        qt.quarter_total_sales,
        100.0 * pqs.prod_quarter_sales / qt.quarter_total_sales as share_pct
    FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_share_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        s1772.prod_id,
        s1772.share_pct as share_1772,
        s1776.share_pct as share_1776,
        s1776.share_pct - s1772.share_pct as share_change_pct_points,
        ABS(s1776.share_pct - s1772.share_pct) as abs_share_change
    FROM product_shares s1772
    JOIN product_shares s1776 ON s1772.prod_id = s1776.prod_id
    WHERE s1772.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
      AND s1776.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        SUM(prod_quarter_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        psc.prod_id,
        psc.share_change_pct_points,
        psc.abs_share_change,
        pt.total_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY pt.total_sales DESC) as sales_quintile
    FROM product_share_changes psc
    JOIN product_totals pt ON psc.prod_id = pt.prod_id
)
SELECT prod_id, share_change_pct_points, abs_share_change, total_sales, sales_quintile
FROM product_with_rank
WHERE sales_quintile = 1
ORDER BY abs_share_change ASC
